A new era awaits. While we complete the next phase of our transformation, the hotel remains temporarily closed. Dukes Bar continues to welcome guests from 3pm, where martinis are still poured tableside, just as they always have been. The Delany Drawing Room also remains open, offering one of London's finest whisky collections alongside cocktails, with its garden providing a peaceful retreat in the heart of St James's. We look forward to welcoming guests back to the house soon. Dukes Bar Alessandro and his team continue to welcome guests for the martinis and classic cocktails for which the bar is known. Explore The Delany Drawing Room Devoted to whisky, The Delany Drawing Room offers signature cocktails, exceptional drams and a programme of distillery-led tastings in an intimate setting designed by Russell Sage Studio. [other: https://www.dukeshotel.com/dukesbar.html] Menu Gift Vouchers Book Now Gift Vouchers Book Now DUKES Bar The Delany Drawing Room Gift Vouchers Gift Vouchers Book Now Dukes Bar “The hotel bar which some say concocts one of the world’s best martinis” – The New York Times Tucked into the heart of St. James's since 1908, Dukes Bar is one of London's most celebrated cocktail destinations. Best known for its iconic martinis, every drink is served with frozen glasses, even colder spirits and, famously, no ice - preserving every nuance of flavour as intended. Whether you're unwinding after a meeting or marking a special occasion, Alessandro and his team continue a tradition that has made Dukes Bar an institution for generations. Your Dukes Martini experience awaits. Information & Opening times Monday to Saturday: 3:00pm – 10:00pm. Last orders are taken at 10:00pm, with the bar closing at 10:30pm. Dukes Bar welcomes guests on a walk-in basis. During busy periods, there may be a short wait for a table. Dress code: Smart casual. Sportswear, shorts and T-shirts are not permitted, with the exception of short-sleeved collared shirts (polo shirts). Guests must be 18 years or over. Only assistance dogs are permitted. The hotel entrance is currently not wheelchair accessible during the refurbishment.
